# T-1: Define validated render contracts

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Create the four invariant-enforcing value objects and align the spec schema with their shared TaskId grammar.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1-R4 constructors own task grammar, collection structure, output confinement, and selected-spec metadata binding.
- Schema ID and parent patterns match TaskId exactly.
- Classes expose validated behavior and values without object-literal type tags or raw-string fallback.
- TaskCollection enforces the existing 200-entry schema boundary with two linear passes, and TaskOutputPath planning creates exactly one path per validated task.

## Implementation Notes
Add `src/spec/lib/render-contract.js`. TaskCollection enforces the existing `tasks.maxItems=200` boundary before allocating per-task maps, then performs two-phase full-set validation. TaskOutputPath accepts TaskId and compares the candidate dirname with the resolved tasks directory. SpecRenderContext reads only the selected directory's flow.json and accepts metadata only on exact selected-spec identity match; otherwise it supplies selected-spec defaults.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local class and schema boundary tables for valid lengths/forms, invalid path-like forms, 0/1/200/201 collection sizes, duplicates, unknown/forward parents, exact path-count equality, direct-child confinement, and matching/mismatched/absent colocated flow metadata.
